description: Recorded (fixture) LLM provider responses for the weave-mini proof-of-recall corpus (W4, spec §6). One CandidateProposal[] batch per corpus document, standing in for what a real LLM would extract from that document's single chunk. Every 'quote' is a byte-verbatim substring of that document's actual chunk text — verified by packages/candidates/src/__tests__/weave-mini-eval.test.ts via the SAME quoteOccursInChunk gate the real pipeline uses (a proposal whose quote drifts from the corpus text is DROPPED, not silently accepted). citedChunkId is intentionally absent here — each corpus document parses+chunks to exactly ONE chunk, so the consuming FixtureProvider stamps citedChunkId from whatever chunk id the pipeline actually assigns.

weave-mini-overview.quote: The Cargo Handling Controller coordinates all cargo handling activity from a central rack-mounted unit.
The Position Sensor Array detects pallet position along the conveyor path.
The Conveyor Drive Motor drives the main conveyor belt at variable speed.
The Load Cell Assembly measures the weight of each pallet as it crosses the load station.
The Detect Cargo Presence function signals the controller when a pallet enters the load zone.
The Compute Load Distribution function calculates the weight distribution across the conveyor deck.
The Monitor Conveyor Speed function tracks belt speed against the commanded setpoint.

weave-mini-overview._comment: TRAP half A: surface form 'Interlock' as a MODE — see weave-mini-subsystem for TRAP half B (same surface form as a COMPONENT). Must NOT auto-cluster or merge-propose together (answer-key.json 'trap').
weave-mini-overview.quote: The system enters the Interlock mode whenever an obstruction is detected on the conveyor path.

weave-mini-subsystem.quote: The CHC executes the top-level cargo handling control loop and mediates all safety interlocks.

weave-mini-subsystem._comment: TRAP half B: surface form 'Interlock' as a COMPONENT — see weave-mini-overview for TRAP half A (same surface form as a MODE).
weave-mini-subsystem.quote: The Interlock isolates power to the conveyor drive within 500 milliseconds of a detected obstruction.
The Boom Actuator raises and lowers the loading boom during pallet transfer.
The Fault Logger records fault events raised by any cargo handling component.

weave-mini-subsystem._comment: Cross-doc EXACT alias of 'Position Sensor Array' (weave-mini-overview) — identical spelling, auto-clusters into ONE cross-document entity.
weave-mini-subsystem.quote: The Position Sensor Array reports pallet position to the CHC over the internal data bus.
The system may enter the Standby mode when no cargo handling activity has been commanded for 10 minutes.
The Validate Load Capacity function confirms that the measured pallet weight is within the rated conveyor capacity.
The Log Fault Event function appends a fault record to the fault logger whenever a component reports an error.
The Transmit Fault Summary function assembles the fault log and Diagnostic Interface status into a per-flight report.
